user.title: New template media player
user.description: Just the basics. After it's created, hit the gear/Configure button on the integration card to add attributes, actions, sources and more.

data_description.base_media_player_entity_id: Optional. Copy state/attributes from this player and forward any action you don't define.
data_description.state: Optional. Renders to on, off, idle, playing, paused, standby or buffering.

error.invalid_template: That template has a syntax error.

init.title: Template Media Player
init.description: Pick a section to edit. Each page saves the moment you hit Submit and the player reloads. Hit 'Save & close' when you're done.

menu_options.services_other: Actions: repeat, shuffle, play media, grouping

general.title: General
general.description: Core settings. Everything here is optional.

data_description.base_media_player_entity_id: Optional. Anything you don't define yourself (state, attributes, actions) is taken from or forwarded to this player.
data_description.state: Must render to one of: on, off, idle, playing, paused, standby, buffering.
data_description.global_template: Pasted in front of every template, re-evaluated each update. Good for {% set tv = 'media_player.tv' %}.
data_description.variables:
YAML dictionary. Values are templates rendered ONCE at startup, usable in every template. Example:
tv: media_player.living_room_tv

attributes_media.title: Media attributes
attributes_media.description: Template. Leave empty to inherit from the base player (if one is set). The variable {{ attribute }} holds the attribute name.

data_description.media_position_updated_at: Timestamp the position was measured. Optional; filled in automatically if you only give a position.
data_description.media_content_rating: Shows up as a plain extra attribute.
data_description.media_summary: Shows up as a plain extra attribute.

attributes_player.title: Player attributes
attributes_player.description: Template. Leave empty to inherit from the base player (if one is set).

data_description.group_members: A list of entity IDs, or a comma separated string.

custom_attributes.title: Custom attributes
custom_attributes.description: Add any extra attributes you want, as a YAML dictionary of name: template.

data_description.custom_attributes:
Example:
room: Living Room
signal: "{{ states('sensor.wifi_signal') }}"

services_playback.title: Actions: playback
services_playback.description: Actions to run when each service is called. Leave empty to use the base player (or nothing).

services_power.title: Actions: power & volume
services_power.description: Actions to run when each service is called.

services_other.title: Actions: other
services_other.description: Actions to run when each service is called.

browse_search.title: Browse / search media
browse_search.description: Borrow another media player's media browser and search.

data_description.browse_media_entity_id: Falls back to the base player if empty.
data_description.search_media_entity_id: Falls back to the base player if empty.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Each source is a name plus the actions that run when someone picks it.

data_description.name: Pick an existing source to edit it, or type a new name.

sources_actions.title: Actions for {name}
sources_actions.description: Runs when this source is selected. Variable: {{ source }}

sound_modes.title: Sound modes
sound_modes.description: Each sound mode is a name plus the actions that run when someone picks it.

menu_options.sound_modes_edit: Add or edit a sound mode

sound_modes_edit.title: Add or edit a sound mode

data_description.name: Pick an existing one to edit it, or type a new name.

sound_modes_actions.title: Actions for {name}
sound_modes_actions.description: Runs when this sound mode is selected. Variable: {{ sound_mode }}
